querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_compcode,
                                      ann_dt,
                                      begin_dt,
                                      end_dt,
                                      report_type,
                                      statement_type,
                                      is_calc,
                                      crncy_code,
                                      net_cash_flows_oper_act,
                                      net_profit_cs,
                                      plus_net_da,
                                      op_cap_change,
                                      oth_noncash_change,
                                      net_cash_flows_inv_act,
                                      cash_recp_fixasset_sell,
                                      less_cap_expense,
                                      less_inv_incr,
                                      inv_decr,
                                      net_oth_icf,
                                      net_cash_flows_fund_act,
                                      debt_incr,
                                      less_debt_decr,
                                      cap_incr,
                                      plus_net_cap_decr,
                                      tot_div_paid,
                                      net_oth_fcf,
                                      e_change_effect,
                                      oth_cf_adjust,
                                      net_incr_cash_cash_equ,
                                      cash_cash_equ_beg_period,
                                      cash_cash_equ_end_period,
                                      s_meno,
                                      s_info_comptype,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_hkgsdcashflow.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.hkgsdcashflow WHERE end_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
